_about: Tidepath's SAMPLE impact sheet: invented, dated facts the outreach agent may cite (same shape as service/org_facts.json). Every source is sample://tidepath/<slug>: a label, never fetched or linked.

facts.title: Fall mentor match
facts.fact: Tidepath matched 42 kids with volunteer mentors this quarter, its largest fall match yet.
facts.quote: 42 kids matched with mentors this quarter

facts.title: Weekend meal bags
facts.fact: Tidepath volunteers packed 1,150 weekend meal bags for 96 families in October.

facts.title: Reading club results
facts.fact: Students in Tidepath's after-school reading club gained an average of 1.4 grade levels in reading over the past school year.

facts.title: Mentor training
facts.fact: Tidepath trained 28 new volunteer mentors at its October mentor academy in Little Haiti.

facts.title: Back-to-school drive
facts.fact: Tidepath's back-to-school drive sent 310 kids to the first day of school with a full backpack and supplies.
facts.quote: 310 kids to the first day of school with a full backpack

facts.title: Summer program wrap-up
facts.fact: Tidepath's six-week summer program served 120 kids with swim lessons, museum trips and daily reading time.

facts.title: Family coaching
facts.fact: Tidepath family coaches helped 64 parents set up budgets, apply for rent help or enroll in classes this year.

facts.title: Mentoring program
facts.fact: Tidepath mentors meet their kids every week for at least a year, and 87% of last year's matches stayed together the full year.
facts.quote: 87% of last year's matches stayed together

facts.title: Neighborhood partners
facts.fact: Nineteen local businesses and firms support Tidepath with grants, volunteer hours and in-kind help.

facts.title: Homework help
facts.fact: Tidepath's homework help nights run four evenings a week at two Miami library branches.
facts.quote: four evenings a week at two Miami library branches
